title: Farm Observability Helm Chart Values
description: JSON Schema validation for the farm-observability Helm chart values.yaml.

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name used in resource names.

fullnameOverride.description: Override the full release name used in resource names.

createNamespace.description: When true, creates the release namespace as a Kubernetes Namespace resource. Set to false when using --create-namespace or when the namespace is managed externally.

kube-prometheus-stack.description: kube-prometheus-stack subchart configuration. See https://github.com/prometheus-community/helm-charts for all available values.

enabled.description: Enable or disable the kube-prometheus-stack subchart.

loki.description: Loki subchart configuration. See https://github.com/grafana/helm-charts for all available values.

enabled.description: Enable or disable the Loki subchart.

tempo.description: Tempo subchart configuration. See https://github.com/grafana/helm-charts for all available values.

enabled.description: Enable or disable the Tempo subchart.

alloy.description: Grafana Alloy subchart configuration. See https://github.com/grafana/helm-charts for all available values.

enabled.description: Enable or disable the Alloy subchart.

pyroscope.description: Pyroscope subchart configuration. See https://github.com/grafana/helm-charts for all available values.

enabled.description: Enable or disable the Pyroscope subchart.
